Which of the following factors most likely would cause an accountant not to accept an engagement to compile the financial statements of a nonissuer?
Option A: A lack of segregation of duties in the entity's accounting and payroll departments.
Option B: Indications that reports of asset misappropriation are not investigated by management.
Option C: The entity's intention to omit from the financial statements substantially all of the disclosures required by GAAP.
Option D: Management's acknowledgement that the financial statements will be included in a written personal financial plan.
